milestones.description: Committed and cryptographically tagged EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md prior to any mutant evaluation.
Committed HELD_OUT_PROTOCOL.md freezing Seed 42 partition (Design: M4,M5,M7,M8,M9; Held-out: M1,M2,M3,M6) and detector code.
Executed frozen detectors on held-out partition; recorded 100.0% out-of-phase generalization vs 0.0%-50.0% baselines.
Evaluated 32 adversarial evasion test cases across 9 archetypes; demonstrated 56.25% recall and documented 14 architectural blindspots.
Evaluated 18 mutants independently authored from abstract taxonomy definitions; achieved 88.89% recall.
Evaluated prospective defect detection at development cutoff 17128c9; demonstrated 80.0% prospective recall.
Evaluated Delta (N=120) and Omicron (N=115) surveillance with Holm-Bonferroni FWER control across M=15 tests.
